content.text:
I've navigated to the Tamiflu side effects page on Drugs.com. Here are the side effects:

## Tamiflu (oseltamivir) Side Effects

**Note:** Most side effects don't need medical attention and resolve on their own. Always check with your doctor if any of the following persist or are bothersome.

### Serious side effects (seek medical attention)
Tamiflu may cause serious effects including **anaphylaxis** (allergic reactions), neuropsychiatric symptoms (e.g., confusion, hallucinations, abnormal behavior), and rare severe skin reactions.

### Less common
- Phlegm-producing cough
- Wheezing

### Rare
- Abdominal/stomach cramps or tenderness
- Arm, back, or jaw pain
- Bloating
- Chest pain or discomfort
- Diarrhea (watery/severe, may be bloody)
- Drooling
- Facial swelling
- Fast or irregular heartbeat
- Hoarseness
- Increased thirst
- Pain
- Shortness of breath
- Unusual weight loss

### By body system (from professional info)
- **Nervous system:** Headache (very common, up to 17%), dizziness, vertigo, drowsiness; rarely seizures/convulsions
- **Gastrointestinal:** Nausea (very common), vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, dyspepsia; rarely pseudomembranous colitis, GI bleeding, hemorrhagic colitis
- **Respiratory:** Nasal congestion, cough, sore throat, bronchitis, nasopharyngitis, sinusitis, rhinorrhea, influenza; rarely pneumonia, peritonsillar abscess, aggravated asthma
- **Psychiatric:** Insomnia; neuropsychiatric events (confusion, abnormal behavior, hallucinations, delirium) — especially in pediatric patients
- **Dermatologic:** Rash, urticaria, eczema, dermatitis; rare serious reactions including toxic epidermal necrolysis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, erythema multiforme, angioneurotic edema
- **Musculoskeletal:** Back pain, arthralgia, myalgia
- **Genitourinary:** Dysmenorrhea
- **Ocular:** Conjunctivitis (red eye, eye discharge, eye pain), visual disturbances
- **Hepatic:** Elevated liver enzymes; rarely hepatic failure, fulminant hepatitis (including fatalities), abnormal liver function tests
- **Hypersensitivity:** Allergic skin reactions, anaphylactic/anaphylactoid reactions, swelling of the face or tongue

**Disclaimer:** This is for informational purposes — consult your healthcare provider for medical advice specific to your situation.
